card.title: Provider status page
card.quote: A power event at 07:08 in zone B

scenes.narration: A power event hit zone B of a cloud region at 07:08. The errors did not stay there.
The status page spoke up at 09:35. Services were restored at 15:00, 7 hours 52 minutes after the fault.

scenes.quote: Some services in the region may see elevated errors
scenes.narration: This is what customers were told while the errors spread to other zones.

scenes.label: other zones
scenes.narration: One power fault in one zone reached the other zones.
